contentText: Four years after ChatGPT went mainstream, generative AI is transforming how we live and work. It's also been a major driver of economic growth, with massive amounts of money poured into expanding global computing capacity. But now, there are signs of a slowdown in AI spending as companies take a reality check: are they getting sufficient returns on their investments and how much artificial intelligence do they actually need?
